people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
translations.bsb: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,
translations.kjv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
translations.asv: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach unto the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ;
